title: 第159章 不忘危
slug: 求生游戏请叫我诚信商人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

从希维尔这里离开，李知去了吴垠的房间。

“给你带的炒饭。”

吴垠有些讶异，“蛋炒饭？”

“对啊。”李知一屁股在她旁边坐下：“虽然和蓝星味道有点区别，但是也挺好吃的，还有蘑菇汤，你试试。”

吴垠的义肢将饭盒

“你上次给我的天启碎晶快用完了，再给我10单位。”

李知瞬间觉得地板坐着硌得慌。

“没有。”

“你连成果和进度都没让我看到，就想要我追加投资？”

吴垠喝了口汤，“昨天那鳞族商人来找你，我放在门口的隐形监控系统，就是我利用天启碎晶的边角料做的，我试过了，只要位置足够隐蔽，S级以下都感应不到，唯一的缺点就是地点要固定。”

李知：“那监控的信息是怎么传输的？”

吴垠：“连接到了我机甲中枢，只要我想，就可以直接看到它的画面，但现在天启碎晶不够，还需要通过玩家面板查看，所以我才问你要更多的天启碎晶。”

她擦擦嘴角，放下勺子，道：“有了天启碎晶，我就有可能让它实现移动隐形，到时候你完全可以带十个八个在身上，四面八方都给你盯紧了，你的仇人一出现，你就能马上逃跑，这还不够让你追加投资？”

李知：“第一，我没有仇人；第二，我还没沦落到如此境地；第三，最多追加1单位，你省着点用，我手里的天启碎晶也不多。”

吴垠：“2单位，1单位都不够我用来升级监控，外装机甲更不用说了。”

李知：“1.5单位，然后你帮我想一个文案，宣传我即将开业的商店，重点需要提到的是强者之心攻略以及翡翠山脉独家永久划取权，再把这个文案制作成传单，精美一点，符合天启大陆的审美，印刷1万张。”

吴垠直接把炒饭重新盖上:“这就是你给我送炒饭的原因？”

李知：“你大学不是拿了广告设计的学位吗？顺手的事。”

吴垠：“李知，你可太是个资本家了，没人比你还懂得怎么把一个人当十个人使。”

“谢谢。”李知：“最好今天晚上之前弄出来，我传单明天就要发，当然，如果你能制造出启元发布游戏任务时，直接出现在天上和个人面板中，让所有种族都必须收到的弹窗广告，我可以把天启碎晶提到15单位。”

“要不你去让启元帮你写文案发广告？”

李知：“以后再说吧。”

Leaving Sivir, Li Zhi went to Wu Yin's room.

"I brought you fried rice."

Wu Yin was a little surprised, "Egg fried rice?"

"That's right." Li Zhi sat down next to her: "Although it tastes a little different from Blue Star, it's still delicious. There's also mushroom soup, you can try it."

Wu Yin's prosthetic leg will be a lunch box

"The apocalypse crystals you gave me last time are almost used up. Give me 10 more units."

Li Zhi instantly felt uncomfortable sitting on the floor.

"No."

"You didn't even let me see the results and progress, so you want me to invest more?"

Wu Yin took a sip of soup and said, "The scale businessman came to see you yesterday. The invisible surveillance system I placed at the door was made from leftover materials from the Apocalypse Crystal. I have tried it. As long as the location is concealed enough, it will not be detected by anyone below S level. The only drawback is that the location must be fixed."

Li Zhi: "Then how is the monitored information transmitted?"

Wu Yin: "It is connected to the center of my mecha. I can directly see its screen whenever I want. However, there are not enough Apocalypse Crystals now. I still need to view them through the player panel, so I asked you for more Apocalypse Crystals."

She wiped the corners of her mouth, put down the spoon, and said: "With the Apocalypse Crystal, I will be able to make it mobile and invisible. Then you can carry ten or eight with you, and you will be watched from all directions. As soon as your enemy appears, you can run away immediately. Isn't this enough for you to invest more?"

Li Zhi: "First, I have no enemies; second, I have not fallen into such a situation; third, I can add at most 1 unit, so you can use it sparingly. I don't have many Apocalypse Crystals in my hand."

Wu Yin: "Two units or one unit are not enough for me to upgrade the surveillance, let alone the external mecha."

Li Zhi: "1.5 units, and then you can help me think of a copy to promote the store I am about to open. The key points to mention are the Heart of the Strong guide and the exclusive and permanent rights to the Emerald Mountains. Then make this copy into a leaflet, which is more beautiful and in line with the aesthetics of Apocalypse Continent. Print 10,000 copies."

Wu Yin covered the fried rice directly: "Is this why you gave me fried rice?"

Li Zhi: "Didn't you get a degree in advertising design from university? It's easy."

Wu Yin: "Li Zhi, you are such a capitalist. No one knows how to treat one person as ten people better than you."

"Thank you." Li Zhi: "It's best to get it out before tonight. I will send out the flyers tomorrow. Of course, if you can create a pop-up advertisement that appears directly in the sky and in the personal panel when Qi Yuan releases the game mission, so that all races must receive it, I can raise the Apocalypse Crystal to 15 units."

"Why don't you ask Qiyuan to help you write copy and distribute advertisements?"

Li Zhi: "Let's talk about it later."
